citations.text: White, J. G., Southgate, E., Thomson, J. N., Brenner, S. (1986). The Structure of the Nervous System of the Nematode Caenorhabditis elegans. Phil. Trans. R. Soc. Lond. B 314, 1-340.

description: Directed multigraph of chemical synapses (types Sp, S, R, Rp) in the adult hermaphrodite C. elegans nervous system. Each synapse is a separate unweighted edge; multiple synapses between the same neuron pair create multi-edges. Gap junctions (EJ) and neuromuscular junctions (NMJ) excluded. No autapses. Data from White et al. 1986 via WormAtlas.
name: C. elegans Hermaphrodite Chemical Connectome
